description: Validate a phone number and return whether it is valid, its line type (mobile/fixed_line/voip/etc), carrier, region, country, and canonical formats (E.164, international, local). Pass numbers in E.164 form (e.g. "+14155552671"); for local numbers supply default_country. Example: veriphone_verify({ phone: "+14155552671", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Veriphone API key (free signup at https://veriphone.io/signup).

default_country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB") used to interpret a number that has no leading "+" country prefix.

phone.description: Phone number to validate. Prefer E.164 format, e.g. "+14155552671". Local numbers are allowed if default_country is supplied.

name: veriphone_verify
title: Veriphone Verify
